sam_sales: FYI Tidewell (regional bank) wants to migrate off RivalAI. Requirements: 1) tight drop-in compatibility for their fraud-check prompts for 2 weeks of A/B, 2) SOC2 + SCIM + IP allowlist answers ASAP, 3) pricing comparison vs their $120k/mo contract. POC timeline: 10 business days if we mirror traffic.
zara_se: Mirroring is best: run RivalAI as primary, mirror requests to Redwood, compare outputs. Need sample traffic (sanitized) + sampling seed to reduce nondeterminism. Propose 5% mirror for 48h smoke then 24/7 for 7d.
leo_infra: To mirror we need a staging endpoint + ingress allowlist. Ops, can we provision a small dedicated sandbox (1 GPU node) and two static IPs for Tidewell test harness?
ops-bot: request received: create-sandbox(tidewell-poc, node_type=g4dn.xlarge, node_count=1, static_ips=2). ETA 4 hours. Automated note: ensure billing center is sales-pocs.
mira_security: On SOC2/PCI checklist: we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS/HSM), TLS1.2+, SCIM 2.0 for provisioning, SSO (SAML/OIDC). Hosted logs retention: 180 days; Dedicated: 365 days. Need to confirm backup purge SLA (hosted ~7d, dedicated 48h).
jasper_legal: Important: fallback clause—Tidewell wants automatic fallback to RivalAI if divergence > threshold. We cannot forward PII to RivalAI. Suggest: either (A) redaction pipeline + explicit consent, or (B) local fallback on their Private deployment. Legal prefers B for PII.
zara_se: Technical parity notes: RivalAI tokenizes differently and applies post-token trimming for stops. We should emulate stop behavior with `compat_stop=post_trim` and offer `tokenizer_mode=rivalai_v2` to reduce diffs. Also RivalAI default is top_p=0.95; if they used that, set sampling params to match.
sam_sales: Can we give them a sample curl for mirroring header?
zara_se: yep, quick example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://proxy.tidewell.example/mirror
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer TIDE-PROXY-KEY'
  -H 'X-Forward-To: https://redwood-staging.example/v1/generate'
  -H 'X-Mirror-Percent: 5'
  -d '{"input":"check transaction 12345", "seed": 42}'
```
This routes primary to RivalAI and copies to Redwood for side-by-side diffs.
leo_infra: Note: streaming vs non-streaming can create diff noise. For parity runs, recommend non-streaming responses (single final output) to avoid partial token differences.
mira_security: Data deletion: for Hosted we can mark primary customer records deleted and purge backups within 7 days; Dedicated/Private can do purge inside 48 hours. Will document with exact endpoints.
jasper_legal: Contract ask: Tidewell wants a parity SLA (semantic match >= 0.9 cosine) and a fallback window. We need to advise on measurable metrics and safe fallback language. I can draft redlines but need product to agree on thresholds.
zara_se: Proposed parity metric: (1) exact-match rate, (2) BLEU / chrF, (3) embedding cosine >= 0.90 on priority intents, (4) manual QA on top 10 flows. Automate via harness that runs 200 queries/day.
sam_sales: Pricing: I'll prepare 3 scenarios: Hosted (PAYG), Dedicated (3/6/12 month commit bands), Private license (one-time + support). Need their monthly token count -> sam to ask Tidewell and share.
leo_infra: Ops note: we'll attach rate-limiting headers so their harness can replay at controlled QPS. Also will provide a dedicated API key scoped to mirror-only.
ops-bot: sandbox(tidewell-poc) created: endpoint=https://redwood-stg.tidewell.internal, static_ips=[34.82.11.9, 34.82.11.10], api_key=stg-TIDE-XXXX. Automated: rotate key after handoff.
mira_security: One more security ask: SCIM provisioning timelines (deprovision within 24h) and auditlog export in CSV/JSON. We provide daily exports and on-demand export via support.
zara_se: Edge-case: RivalAI returns n-best lists and does internal reranking; to mimic we can return n-best + apply same reranker or present top-1 with `rerank_emulation=true`. That reduces A/B surprise.
sam_sales: Action items: 1) sam: ask Tidewell for monthly token counts + sample traffic (owner: sam_sales, ETA: today), 2) zara: build mirror harness + parity diffs (owner: zara_se, ETA: 3 days), 3) mira: SOC2 answers doc (owner: mira_security, ETA: 24h), 4) leo: validate sandbox & send IPs/creds (owner: leo_infra/ops-bot, ETA: 6h), 5) jasper: draft fallback/legal redlines (owner: jasper_legal, ETA: 48h).
jasper_legal: I'll loop legal and put draft into drive.
sam_sales: I'll schedule kickoff with Tidewell for tomorrow 10am ET once mirror endpoint is live. Keep this thread tight—flag blockers here. :rocket:
